title: Canonicalize and bound multi-instance lock declarations
problem: Lock conflict checks compare raw output strings, while actual task paths normalize cwd and '..'; equivalent paths such as docs/a/../shared.md and docs/shared.md are admitted as disjoint. The preflight source scan also uses unbounded Path.read_text.
acceptance: Equivalent relative, absolute, and '..' output paths conflict and return LOCK_EXIT_CODE.
Oversized, invalid-UTF8, symlinked, or FIFO source files cannot bypass bounded preflight or hang it.
Existing genuinely disjoint declarations remain eligible for parallel execution.

title: Prevent artifact writes through symlinked parent directories
problem: Artifact saving checks only whether the final unresolved output component is a symlink, then resolves ancestors and creates temporary files under the resolved parent. A symlinked parent can therefore redirect both validated and unvalidated artifacts, including sidecars, outside the intended path.
acceptance: Symlinked ancestor directories are rejected by both save paths and sidecar writes.
A race replacing an output component with a symlink cannot modify an external sentinel.
Normal nested regular-file outputs and existing final-symlink tests remain green.

title: Preserve declaration order for parallel stage evidence
problem: runner_parallel._collect appends results in as_completed order. pipeline_native then builds stage outputs from that order, although evidence.combine_outputs promises declared ordering. Completion timing can therefore change aggregate prompts, downstream inputs, and reuse fingerprints.
acceptance: Parallel results are returned in original task order despite differing completion times.
Mixed reused and newly generated outputs retain declaration order in downstream evidence.
Live result callbacks may remain completion-ordered while aggregate prompts are deterministic.
